verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a first-party choice of where analytics data lives. Warehouse Native runs on top of your own data warehouse with no ETL, or you can host the data in Statsig's infrastructure. That gives customers meaningful control over storage location, but nothing describes selecting a geographic region or residency guarantees for Statsig-hosted data. Missing for 10: explicit region selection (e.g., EU/US) for Statsig-hosted data, documented residency commitments, independent corroboration.
